description: The basic edition provides only fundamental chart rendering. IIChartBasic is the basic edition of the native MFC/Win32 chart control that ports Apache ECharts through WebView2, supporting both x86 and x64 platforms. Official website: https://www.xw-industrial.com/ ; Github: https://github.com/Xuwei…

The standard edition adds visual style customization for charts on top of the basic edition. IIChartStandard is the standard edition of the native MFC/Win32 chart control that ports Apache ECharts through WebView2, supporting both x86 and x64 platforms. Official website: https://www.xw-industrial.c…
